title: fix(pm): dispatch-gates derives the CLI command-id, ADR anchor and error-code provenance gates from the diffs that break them
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XFw5wfsCwD3s72yDS2BVkmT)_

Fixes #30763

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`dispatch-gates --commands` 新增两种「按改动内容判定」的门禁派生,并给已有的错误码派生补上一道门禁:改到含 CLI 命令字面量的源码或 CLI 命令文件时派生 `check:cli-command-ids`;改到被 ADR 按符号锚定的文件(或移走/删掉任何被锚定的文件)时派生 `check:adr-symbol-anchors`;改到含错误码字面量的文件时,除原有的词表门禁外再派生 `check:error-code-provenance`。
- 为什么改:这三道门禁在 CI 里每个 PR 都跑,但本地派生清单从不列出它们,开发者报「全绿」后 CI 才红,已各自付过一轮 CI(PR #30734、#30749、#31214)。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `scripts/pm/` 下的派生工具与其自测,不改任何门禁检查什么,也不动 workflow;最坏情况是多派生一道门禁(多跑几秒)或漏派生(即现状)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` 的 `carriesACliCommandLiteral` 与 `breaksAnAdrAnchor`;`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` 新增的三条 `CHANGE_KIND_ROWS` 门禁行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/apply.ts packages/services/service-push/src/push-plugin.ts`,预期输出里有 `pnpm check:cli-command-ids` 与 `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors`(main 上两者都没有)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Three lint steps run on every PR (`lint.yml`, no `paths:` filter) over a population no path trigger in `dispatch-gates` reached, so `--commands` never handed them to a card. Each now reaches a card through a change-kind row (`CHANGE_KIND_ROWS`), the same channel the vocabulary, status and durability gates already use:

| Gate | Why it was never derived | Now derived when the diff… |
|---|---|---|
| `check:cli-command-ids` | Its literal population is a `src` path segment in any package (no subtree spelling covers it); its only declared root is `scripts/**`. Its command-module duty spells the commands dir package-relative. | …holds a quoted binary-name literal in a non-test JS/TS file outside the CLI (content), or touches a CLI command module or the CLI manifest (path, so a deleted or renamed command counts). |
| `check:adr-symbol-anchors` | Declared population is `docs/adr/**` only; an anchor also reds from the anchored file's end. | …edits a file some ADR anchors by `path#Symbol`, or moves/deletes a file any ADR anchors. The anchored files are read with the gate's own corpus registration and the shared extractor (`scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs`), cross-repo anchors left out. |
| `check:error-code-provenance` | Its only declared literals are the ledger file, so it sat in the artifact-roster block, outside `--commands`. | …carries an error-code-shaped value: it joins `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` on the existing `error-code-literal` row (same stamp sites, population-disjoint verdicts). |

**`check:cli-command-ids`: content, not every diff.** The step is unconditional in CI, but at about 22 s locally it is not cheap (ADR anchors ~7 s, provenance ~6 s), so a for-every-diff family was rejected per the order's precision rule. The literal limb is a net around the gate's reader, not a copy of it: the gate's module loads `typescript` at import time and `dispatch-gates` runs in checkouts with no install, so it is not imported. The self-test holds the net to the gate's own `binNamesOf` and `literalsOn` in a child process.

## Tests

New self-test cases in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`:

- **CLI kind:** the PR #30734 shape (a pt-BR fragment opening with the binary word) and the other limbs through an injected reader; negatives: a comment-opening line, jsdoc, unquoted prose, `osx`, test files, `__tests__`, non-JS, CLI source outside its commands dir, no declared CLI. Live: CLI discovered from its manifest, a command module reached, discrimination (424 of 7002). Gate-reader parity in a child process: same binary names, and every file the gate's reader finds a literal in is inside the net (missed: none). Rendering, whole table, runnable union, STALE.
- **ADR kind:** symbol-anchored edit/delete hit; file-level-only edit not a hit, its move/delete a hit; unanchored never. Reader against a scratch corpus: symbol plus continuation, file-level, cross-repo and fenced sample left out, empty corpus throws. Live: 150 records, the PR #30749 file reached, discrimination. Rendering, whole table, runnable union, STALE.
- **Provenance:** rides the `error-code-literal` row; the #31214 shape (a scenarios-package constant bound to `VALIDATION_FAILED`) derives it through the whole table; the section now carries both code gates.
- Census guard: all three are live families.
- One existing pin moved: the inherited-population census row 738 → 744 (the import lines above it).

**Ablation** (one fast-tier run, both guards removed through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the first held and the second in run mode, restore proven: blob == HEAD `098f38af9ac9`, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- CLI net loses its comment-line skip ⇒ red: "a line that opens as a comment is not a hit", "…nor a jsdoc line".
- ADR predicate loses its on-disk check ⇒ red: "an edit to a file anchored only at file level is not a hit".
- Also red, in the "more diagnostics" direction: three whole-table section-count pins on live i18n / metadata-form / gate-script paths, because the widened net then fires on comment-only mentions in those files. The three new pins above are the ones that name the guard; every other case stayed green (6 of 2021 red).

## Acceptance notes

- **Third reading (#31214), measured at head `813399e1`:** `--commands` on that PR's 17 paths printed 54 commands and not `check:error-code-provenance`; the human rendering listed it under "Artifact rosters" (outside the runnable total). The `error-code-literal` kind already fired on 5 of the paths (`scenario-operation-grade.ts` bound `VALIDATION_FAILED_CODE: ErrorCode = 'VALIDATION_FAILED'`). Same defect class, so fixed here. With this branch's tool on that tree: 56 commands, `+ check:error-code-provenance`, `+ check:cli-command-ids`. Recall of the predicate against the gate's own `--report` at fe97d85b: 162 of 162 site files; the gate's any-name constant limb adds 0 files the predicate does not reach.
- **Census of the class (not fixed here; for one closing card).** Unconditional `lint.yml` steps over a whole-root population that `--commands` does not derive for a diff outside their home package (probe: `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts`):
  - Declared WIDE (11), rendered in their own block, never in `--commands`: `check:init-service-contract`, `check:live-db-isolation`, `check:meta-type-normalized`, `check:optional-error-sink`, `check:resume-authority-declared`, `check:route-envelope`, `check:runner-env-posture`, `check:settings-bind-window`, `check:startup-registry-verdict`, `check:verify-stand-in`, `check:wildcard-fallthrough`.
  - Artifact-roster families whose gate source walks a whole root and that no change kind reaches (7): `check:stack-collection-maps`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:tenant-chokepoint`, `check:object-def-param-keys`, `check:published-readme-exports`. Read from a walk/`ls-files` signature in each gate's source; population width not measured per family.
  - Roster families a change kind already reaches: `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:error-status-conformance`, and now `check:error-code-provenance`.
  - Type-check lanes are conditional (affected-selected), so outside this census.
- **Not done here:** making `--commands` emit the roster or wide blocks. That is a choice for the seat, put in the report as an open question.
- Bounded by the order: no `.github/**` edit, and no change to what any gate checks.

## Verification

Gate union derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this diff (30 families), run on head `2653b6b1` (after merging `origin/main`), reconciled with `--ran`: "30 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 30 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero …)".

<details><summary>30 gates, exit codes captured before any pipe</summary>

- `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` (and `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`, `check-declaration-mirrors.mjs` (and `--self-test`), `check-self-test-wired.mjs` (and `--self-test`), `check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs` (and `--self-test`), `check-whole-set-label-write.mjs` (and `--self-test`), `ci/plan-test-core-shards.mjs --self-test`: exit 0 each
- `pnpm check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:bash32-floor`, `check:ci-filter-parity`, `check:cli-command-ids` (19 s), `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:declared-population-live`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:parse-guard`, `check:pnpm-filter-targets`, `check:pnpm-flag-spellings`, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check:watch-hint-literal`: exit 0 each
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`: exit 0, "✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 2021 cases pass; 7 slow section(s) deferred."

</details>

- Full battery (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test`, the slow tier CI runs on `main` only): on head `2653b6b1`, "✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2310 cases pass." (fast 2021 cases in 428 s, slow 289 cases in 1363 s).
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the three files: exit 0. No package touched, so no package `lint`/`test`/`typecheck` is owed.
- CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.
